scope: Reanalysis of published regulatory resources, with exact candidate/variant matching; no newly trained regulatory model or new colocalization/MR
genetic_pairs: Frozen Hamel pilot baseline-passing locus-rsID-gene pairs
index_variants: Original index rsIDs only; no invented LD proxies or rsID aliases
genome: GRCh38 variant mappings from the retained Ensembl response; source intervals converted to 0-based half-open BED comparisons
primary_ATAC: Wang 2022 Data S2 all reproducible peaks; Data S3 nearest-gene marker annotations are a separate, weaker evidence layer
target_gene_evidence: Wang 2022 Data S6: predicted targets, co-accessible promoters, HiChIP links and retina eQTL links retained as separate categories
deep_learning: Import Wang Data S8 original scores and high-effect calls, including negative results; no retraining or newly calibrated effect probabilities
additional_ATAC: Yuan 2026 Table S6 source-listed human retina/macula cCREs; source nominal p-values are not new significance tests; microglia absent from the supplied table
ABC_pair_policy: Do not infer peak-gene pairs by row order in separate peak and gene matrices without an explicit pair identifier or author-confirmed pairing
independence: Wang RNA/ATAC are from the same multiome study; reused retinal eQTL evidence is not counted as independent genetic replication
status: Specification frozen before module execution; not an externally registered preregistration
